Given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta =2,$ the **exact** area of $△ABC$ shown above is{{field-1}} square units.
worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot AC.
$$

We are given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta =2,$ where $\theta =m∠A.$ Notice we're also given the length of the side $\overset{―}{AC}$ adjacent to $∠A.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to find the length of the opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta  & =\frac{BC}{AC} \\ 2 & =\frac{BC}{15} \\ BC & =2\cdot 15 \\ BC & =30\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot AC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 30\cdot 15 \\  & =225.\end{aligned}
$$
